title: The merge tool pages open PRs by number, so a cloud merge works with many PRs open
why: Blocker (coordinator, 15:33 CST Nov 7): every claude-settings merge fails in the cloud. With 194 open PRs, the merge tool's --paginate follows a Link with a numeric id, and the proxy refuses it with a 403.
note: Done check: a cloud merge with more than one page of open PRs succeeds, and a red test shows the old paging fail. Done: #1634 merged in batch 61 (#1734), merge commit 394ad4863, 21:30 CST Nov 7; main's merge tool pages in the cloud now (coordinator 21:33 CST; updated 21:33 CST).
